summary: Register AliExpress RU as a deliberately narrow read-only marketplace provider using only the Russia-facing seller API path, admitting products.read while fail-closed deferring stock, price and order capabilities that lack current repository-qualified Russia contracts.

impacts.evidence: The provider receives only the authenticated connector account/runtime; it owns no tenant selectors or tenant persistence.
Only product/SKU metadata is admitted. Order reads are explicitly deferred, so buyer/contact payloads cannot enter this baseline. Fixtures are synthetic and JWT bytes remain callback-scoped.
Task 036 adds no public TORGNEXA HTTP/OpenAPI operation.
Task 036 publishes no new EventBus or webhook schema.
The provider reuses the existing ProductReader SDK-v1 surface and does not modify frozen Connector/Runtime roots or add a new capability interface.
No migration is added; connector account, mapping, sync and reconciliation persistence already exist.

JWT is available only through SecretAccessor callbacks, requests are fixed-host and host-mediated, bodies/cursors are bounded, and raw remote/transport text is not disclosed. Provider code has no direct database/filesystem/process/Core/App authority.
The manifest grants only products.read. All marketplace mutations and even unqualified stock/price/order reads remain denied.
Remote reads do not directly mutate canonical state; any later Sync Engine application remains under existing audit/lineage policy.

Product id and sku_id remain remote mapping keys, ali_updated_at is preserved as UTC observation time, and pagination uses a versioned surface-bound last_product_id cursor. Deprecated stock fields are never promoted into inventory state.
Outbound Russia seller API requests use host-injected transport to fixed openapi.aliexpress.ru; no inbound webhook capability is granted.
Auth/rate/service outcomes normalize to bounded SDK health/errors. Manifest pacing is intentionally conservative relative to published seller limits; live account behavior remains staging evidence.
Suspend the connector account or remove the provider route to stop reads; no database rollback is required.

Synthetic/adversarial tests cover JWT validation, Russia product pagination/projection, duplicate IDs, cursor tampering, remote error-body suppression and deprecated-stock non-authority; the Task-064 provider report passes all thirteen checks.
